verdict.rationale: Gemini's entire interaction model is natural-language: users type or speak requests to trigger actions across apps (Connected Apps), scheduling, image generation, research, and coding tasks (gemini-docs-10, gemini-docs-12, gemini-docs-30, gemini-docs-48), and Gemini Live/Hey Google support fully voice-driven natural conversation (gemini-docs-6, gemini-docs-34, gemini-docs-40). Community evidence corroborates real-world use via natural prompts for tasks like codebase analysis and OCR (gemini-comm-13, gemini-comm-17), though it also notes accuracy limits on some tasks (gemini-comm-9, gemini-comm-18) which affects quality but not the core capability. Missing for 10: independent verification of complex multi-step natural-language command chains and a documented command-only mode without GUI fallback.
